13:10.race_name: Ladbrokes "New Horse Racing Bet Builder" Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Third at Aintree last spring; career best needed under topweight after 11 months off
runners.name: Favour And Fortune
runners.spotlight: Won the Scottish Champion Hurdle (2m, soft) in April 2024 and showed he stays 2m4f when a good third of 20 at Aintree last spring; not ruled out but he'll need a career best to defy topweight after 11 months off.

runners.comment: Back over hurdles with creditable run at Windsor; pick of Dan Skelton's on jockey bookings
runners.name: Royal Infantry
runners.spotlight: Chasing was shelved after just one attempt, and he returned to hurdling with a creditable run in conditions event at Windsor last month, although finishing last of five; will have no problem with trip or ground and looks the pick of Dan Skelton's three on jockey bookings.

runners.comment: Formerly trained by Willie Mullins; hardly looks thrown in on handicap hurdle debut
runners.name: Charlus
runners.spotlight: Formerly trained by Willie Mullins; best effort over hurdles when second in conditions event at Punchestown (2m, heavy) in December; third when falling two out next time; hardly looks thrown in on handicap hurdle debut so probably best watched on first outing for a new yard.

runners.comment: Veteran; won conditionals' event at Ascot in December; more required off 5lb higher
runners.name: Whatsupwithyou
runners.spotlight: Veteran who goes well for Elliott England, gaining his second success for this rider in conditionals' event at Ascot (2m5f, soft) in December; no obvious reason why he won't be thereabouts again but he'll need more off 5lb higher.

runners.comment: Holding his form well, second of five at Taunton five weeks ago; firmly in the mix again
runners.name: Bourbali
runners.owner: W Pope E Legg M Green & T Swaffield
runners.spotlight: Mixes chasing with hurdling and holding his form well, making most of the running when 3l second of five at Taunton (2m3f, good to soft) five weeks ago; firmly in the mix again.

runners.comment: Fourth in Lanzarote over C&D; should be in the thick of things again off an unchanged mark
runners.name: Fasol
runners.owner: P J Vogt And Bryan Drew
runners.spotlight: 2-3 for Olive Nicholls and the defeat was a highly creditable fourth of 15 in the Lanzarote over C&D (good ground; handles soft) last month; should be in the thick of things again off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: 2-2 in novices since wind surgery; this is tougher but he's completely unexposed
runners.name: Hold The Serve
runners.spotlight: Good-ground Irish point winner; flopped on hurdling debut but hasn't looked back since wind surgery, winning novices at Wincanton (2m4f, soft) and Market Rasen (2m2f, good to soft) with plenty in hand; this is a tougher test of his credentials but he's unexposed and commands major respect.

runners.comment: Well below par last two starts; still 2lb higher than for latest win; others appeal more
runners.name: Tranquil Sea
runners.spotlight: Successful at Chepstow (3m, good) in October on second start for this yard; well below par on last two starts and he's still 2lb higher than for the win; others appeal more.

runners.breeder: A F G & Mrs S L Brimble
runners.comment: Upwardly mobile 6yo; beaten head at Chepstow last month; strong candidate off 2lb higher
runners.name: Grenadier Jed
runners.spotlight: Upwardly mobile 6yo; won three handicaps in 2025 and posted another personal best when beaten a head at Chepstow (2m3f, soft) last month, pulling well clear of the third; strong candidate off just 2lb higher.

runners.comment: Won first four hurdle races and good second to a smart type last time; in the mix again
runners.name: One Horse Town
runners.spotlight: 1m4f winner on Flat; has taken well to hurdling, winning his first four races and running up to his best when 2l second to the unbeaten Maestro Conti in Grade 2 at Cheltenham (2m1f, soft) four weeks ago, headed only on run-in; successful over C&D; likely to give another good account of himself.

runners.comment: Ready winner over C&D last month; promising sort, open to plenty more progress
runners.name: Precious Man
runners.spotlight: Runner-up to One Horse Town on British debut at Cheltenham (heavy ground) in November and improved form (after wind surgery) when going one better over C&D (good) last month, in control when left clear at the last; promising sort, open to plenty more progress; probably the one to beat.

runners.comment: French-trained; useful on Flat and shaped well when second on hurdling debut; interesting
runners.name: Allure
runners.owner: Ecurie David R Layani Family & Allure Invest
runners.spotlight: French-trained gelding; useful on the Flat for Andre Fabre, placed in 1m7f Listed event, and made an encouraging start over hurdles when a close second of 14 at Fontainebleau (2m2f, soft; caught late on after going clear) in December; likely to step up on that form and interesting in a first-time tongue-strap.

runners.comment: Won on hurdling debut then raced too freely last time; Harry Cobden takes over today
runners.name: Falls Of Acharn
runners.spotlight: 2-4 on the Flat in Ireland; scrambled home on hurdling debut at Musselburgh on New Year's Day; finished last of six in Listed race over same C&D (again good to soft) four weeks later, although he wasn't beaten far after racing too freely; remains open to improvement if settling better and Harry Cobden takes over in the saddle today.

runners.comment: Listed winner on Flat; disappointing on hurdling debut last Sunday; needs major step up
runners.name: Fantasy World
runners.spotlight: 1m6f Listed winner on Flat who changed hands for 600,000gns last autumn; went off long odds-on for hurdling debut at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) last Sunday but compromised his chance by racing freely/jumping none too fluently and could finish only fourth; it's far too soon to be writing him off but he needs a major leap forward just six days on.

runners.comment: Won first two races and better than result in Grade 2 at Cheltenham last time; likely type
runners.name: La Luna Artista
runners.spotlight: Off to a flying start in Exeter bumper (good to firm) and Warwick juvenile hurdle (good to soft), and she ran well when upped in class for Grade 2 juvenile at Cheltenham (2m1f, soft) four weeks ago; has a bit to find with One Horse Town on that last run, but she met some trouble that day and she's unexposed; gets weight all round and not to be underestimated.

runners.comment: 5-9 over jumps; personal best when winning at Musselburgh; should be involved again
runners.name: Go West
runners.spotlight: 5-9 over jumps; posted a personal best when winning novice handicap at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) three weeks ago, seeing off several challengers from four out; goes well with positive tactics; should be involved again.

runners.comment: Has taken well to fences; clearcut winner at Sandown last time; sets the standard
runners.name: Jax Junior
runners.spotlight: Bled from the nose at Ascot just before Christmas but otherwise he's made a fine start to his chasing career, winning handicap at Sandown (1m7f, soft) three weeks ago in clearcut style; just as effective at 2m4f and sets the standard for the others to aim at.

runners.comment: Might have won over C&D but for falling two out; stiffer task here but going the right way
runners.name: Old Cowboy
runners.spotlight: Just one win from six attempts over hurdles but already better over fences; ready winner of handicap at Newbury (2m, good) in December and might have followed up over this C&D but for falling two out when a narrow leader (bled from the nose); needs further improvement but he's going the right way.

runners.comment: Mares' Listed chase winner last time; now takes on male rivals but impossible to discount
runners.name: Jasmine Bliss
runners.owner: Noel Fehily Racing Syndicate - Jasmine B
runners.spotlight: Added to point, bumper and hurdles wins when battling on gamely in mares' Listed chase at Huntingdon (2m4f, soft) 16 days ago; that was a career best and she may not have reached her ceiling just yet; faces a sterner assignment against male rivals but impossible to discount.

runners.comment: Improving with each run and won in clearcut style over C&D on Boxing Day; solid claims
runners.name: Klub De Reve
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; building a solid foundation under rules, improving with each run and winning in clearcut style over C&D (good ground; handles good to soft) on Boxing Day; tactically versatile; solid claims.

runners.comment: Sprang surprise in four-runner race at Musselburgh; going the right way and not ruled out
runners.name: Onlyforfrankie
runners.spotlight: Progressive over hurdles, springing a surprise in four-runner novice at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) three weeks ago; bred to be at least as effective over 2m4f+; going the right way and not ruled out.

runners.comment: Beaten 24l in this race 12 months ago; raced too freely on return; something to find
runners.name: Blues Singer
runners.spotlight: Beaten 24l into fourth in this race 12 months ago, and he raced too freely when 13l third of eight at Newbury in December on first outing since; may not be fully exposed but has something to find on the figures.

runners.comment: Made all in canter on only hurdles outing; meets stronger opposition but could be anything
runners.name: Desertmore News
runners.spotlight: Third in an Irish point in November; well backed on rules debut and was impressive in maiden hurdle at Southwell (2m, good to soft) three weeks ago, making all in a canter; meets stronger opposition here but could be anything.

runners.comment: Easy winner at Huntingdon and gives the impression there's plenty more in the tank
runners.name: Double Measure
runners.spotlight: 1-1 in bumpers and learning on the job over hurdles, easily landing the odds with the minimum of fuss in maiden at Huntingdon (2m, soft) last month; gives the impression there's plenty more in the tank and makes the most appeal.

runners.breeder: A Peltier D Juste & J Houdin
runners.comment: Beaten favourite at Kelso last Friday; in the mix but others appeal more for the win
runners.name: Kocktail Bleu
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite at Kelso (2m, heavy) last Friday but he'd previously run well when second over C&D (good); should be thereabouts but others appeal more for the win.

runners.breeder: Bertwood Stables & Mrs H De Soultrait
runners.comment: 0-3 in bumpers but showed promise; has joined top stable; needs a market check
runners.name: Lexington Wood
runners.spotlight: 0-3 in bumpers in Ireland but he showed promise, going down narrowly at Down Royal (yielding) in November; changed hands for £105,000 afterwards, and it's interesting that new connections throw him in at the deep end for his hurdling debut; unexposed and should be monitored in the market.

runners.comment: Point and bumper winner who scored over hurdles last month; getting better all the time
runners.name: Loaded And Locked
runners.spotlight: Won point and bumper in 2025 and added an easy hurdles success to his CV in 14-runner race at Hereford (2m, good to soft) last month; as things stand he still has a bit to find but he's getting better all the time.

runners.comment: Doncaster winner; clear of third in handicap there last time; that form sets the standard
runners.name: Storming George
runners.spotlight: Fifth in Grade 2 bumper at Aintree last spring and, bar one blip, has made a good impression over hurdles, winning at Doncaster (2m, soft) in November and pulling clear of the third when runner-up in handicap there (2m3f, soft) 16 days ago; that form sets the standard and he commands respect.

runners.comment: Winner/third in hood last two starts; should give running but others have more potential
runners.name: Anariza
runners.spotlight: Hooded last two starts, winning at Wetherby in November and a creditable third at Windsor (again 2m, soft) last month; will probably give her running again but Jack Andrews jumps ship in favour of Desertmore News and others probably have more potential.

runners.comment: Impressive winner at Doncaster on stable debut; still holds a Triumph entry; promising
runners.name: Mustang Du Breuil
runners.spotlight: Overcame mistakes to win on debut at Auteuil (2m2f, heavy) in the autumn and made an impressive start for new connections in 4yo event at Doncaster (2m, good to soft; 4-7) 16 days ago; more on his plate against older rivals but he's clearly promising and still holds an entry in the Triumph.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo; easy winner at Newbury; more improvement required but that's possible
runners.name: Matiwo
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo; put everything together when winning at Newbury (2m, good to soft) in January, racing freely in front and pulling further clear on run-in; the basic form is just fair but he's anything but exposed and must be considered.

15:35.race_name: Ladbrokes Trophy Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Has the class to feature with Harry Atkins taking off 7lb; wouldn't want soft ground
runners.name: Boombawn
runners.spotlight: Only 2-14 as a chaser but has been highly tried on occasions, as when not far away in a 2m4f Grade 1 at Aintree last April; another good run in a Grade 2 here last month (RPR right up there with his best) and soft ground was no good to him back in a handicap at Cheltenham; patient tactics are likely now sent further and could be interesting with Harry Atkins claiming 7lb, provided conditions don't soften.

runners.comment: Front-runner; 2lb above last winning mark but others in here are probably better in
runners.name: Henrys Friend
runners.spotlight: Back to form when 5l behind Deep Cave last time at Ascot (3m, good to soft) but he does look vulnerable to better-treated opposition, for all that he's just 2lb higher than for November's win at Ascot; likely to race on the front end.

runners.comment: Only 2l off The Doyen Chief over C&D last time but he's probably better at shorter trips
runners.name: Soul Icon
runners.spotlight: His best form is over shorter, including last season's 2m Grade 2 victory here off the same mark as today; whether he wants 3m is questionable, for all that he was only 2l off The Doyen Chief here last month.

runners.comment: Never turned up at Doncaster last time but very progressive prior to that; on a good mark
runners.name: Deep Cave
runners.spotlight: Well regarded by a trainer who excels with staying chasers; a willing partner in securing 3m wins at Bangor (soft) and Ascot (good to soft), leading right on the line latterly; never turned up at Doncaster four weeks ago but he's a lot better than that; enters the reckoning off what remains a handy mark.

runners.comment: Only 1lb higher than for recent C&D success and the second ran well last weekend
runners.name: The Doyen Chief
runners.spotlight: Closely matched with Deep Cave on their Bangor clash in November (soft) and, back at 3m from 3m2f, he dug deep for a course win last month (good); only went up 1lb for that and the runner-up ran well in defeat last weekend at Ascot.

runners.comment: Improving chaser with a sporting chance of seeing out this longer trip; on a good mark
runners.name: Lookaway
runners.spotlight: A front-runner and not the only one; however, he was a Grade 2-winning hurdler and very much heading the right way over fences, as his third at Newbury (2m, good to soft) has worked out well and he then won by 24l over 2m4f here last month (left clear two out) despite being taken on by Leader In The Park; looks well in off only 4lb higher and, although unraced over this far, he's always looked a strong stayer at 2m4f.

runners.comment: 11lb higher than for last year's win but got back on track with a 2nd at Cheltenham latest
runners.name: Katate Dori
runners.spotlight: Always wears a tongue-tie; on a sharp upward curve when taking this 12 months ago by some 15l (on good to soft); makes his defence off an 11lb higher mark but on the back of a return to form at Cheltenham (in cheekpieces; wore a visor in this last year); course form here always ticks a big box and can run well again.

runners.comment: Admirable veteran who is bang in form but faces competition for the lead
runners.name: Gustavian
runners.spotlight: Jumped well and dominated throughout in the Badger Beers at Wincanton (3m1f, good; handles softer) and gave it another good go off this 8lb higher mark at Sandown; assured competition for the lead here has to reduce his appeal.

runners.comment: Running well at Cheltenham; now in cheekpieces and both chase wins were right handed
runners.name: Hoe Joly Smoke
runners.spotlight: Won twice as a novice chaser over 3m at Sandown (soft/good); has been running well in some strong Cheltenham handicaps this season without looking that well handicapped, but returning to a right-handed track might benefit him, as might the first-time cheekpieces; could also have this run to suit if he's held up as usual; effective from 2m4f to 3m1f, he's a big player.

runners.comment: C&D winner in November (7lb lower) and subsequent defeats have been at about 2m
runners.name: Chance Another One
runners.spotlight: Better chaser than hurdler; this is a much deeper race than the one he won by more than 4l over C&D in November (good; effective on softer) but unwise to read too much into his subsequent defeats in Ireland that were at about 2m; a 7lb higher mark than for that last win could count, however.

runners.comment: Got competitive too far out when a remote second to Lookaway here last time; can do better
runners.name: Leader In The Park
runners.spotlight: Hasn't raced over 3m since winning his Irish point; probably a career best when second over 2m6f at Newbury on reappearance (good to soft) but couldn't live with Lookaway when both got competiitve a good way out over 2m4f here last month; regular partner Ben Jones prefers Henry's Friend but Harry Cobden's style could suit this 8yo.

runners.comment: Improving first-season novice who looks ready for this first crack at 3m
runners.name: Kdeux Saint Fray
runners.spotlight: Anthony Honeyball does well in staying chasers and he won this two years ago; he has another likely contender in this first-season chaser who probably improved on his winning piece of form at Cheltenham when a staying-on fourth in a traditionally strong novice handicap there on Trials' Day; confined to about 2m4f over fences thus far but looks ready for 3m and big shout if his jumping stands the test.

runners.comment: Irish raider on a roll; he's up in grade but Sean Bowen rides off a feather weight
runners.name: Rising Dust
runners.spotlight: A major improver since joining Emmet Mullins, winning twice over hurdles in the autumn and now arrives here on a four-timer over fences after three wins at Thurles (2m5f-3m1f); tackling a different level of opposition now but Sean Bowen rides off a feather weight and he could be dangerous.

16:05.race_name: "Join Ladbrokes Bet £5 Get £30" Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Aggressive rides in cheekpieces have got him back on track the last twice; respected
runners.name: Etalon
runners.spotlight: Has his share of off days but the new cheekpieces floated his boat when making all at Ascot before Christmas (2m3f, good to soft) and again when third there a month ago, perhaps stretched by the 2m5f on soft; off the same mark as that day he has to be feared.

runners.comment: Ran on too late in the day when second at Ascot; 3-3 here, including this race last year
runners.name: Bad
runners.spotlight: Has his quirks but talented and his win in this last year was the first of three victories at this track (2m2f-2m4f); he's close to a career-high mark, off which he went close last month at Ascot (2m5f, soft) despite looking disinterested early doors; a danger to all.

runners.comment: Front-runner who won over 3m latest; can go well for a long way back at 2m4f
runners.name: Viroflay
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D hunter chase last season from the front, as is his way; last two races have also been here over 3m, jumping better than his rivals the last time when 4lb lower; looks sure to go well for a long way back at 2m4f.

runners.comment: Four quiet runs since winning an intermediate chase at Newton Abbot in October
runners.name: Riskintheground
runners.spotlight: Outclassed behind Haiti Couleurs at Newbury recently but that was his fourth successive quiet run since winning an intermediate chase at Newton Abbot in October.

runners.comment: Running well on handicap debut latest before a mistake two out halted his momentum
runners.name: Califet En Vol
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner, including at Listed level; ran well behind smart horses in two 2m4f novices at Cheltenham and was running well on handicap debut there until a mistake two out halted his momentum; remains capable of a lot better no doubt.

runners.comment: Beat a notable horse in his novice chase but that was in 2022 and off since
runners.name: Loughderg Rocco
runners.spotlight: Has a mammoth absence to overcome but he did beat subsequent Cheltenham Festival winner Unexpected Party in a novice chase at Leicester back in late 2022 (2m4f, good; a winner on good to soft); the market may suggest whether he's still capable of that level of form on debut for Olly Murphy.

runners.comment: Has the form to feature and this is easier than two high-profile handicaps at Cheltenham
runners.name: Es Perfecto
runners.spotlight: Has some strong handicap form to his name and this isn't quite so demanding as Cheltenham's feature 2m4f early-season handicaps; he is now 11 and the handicapper hasn't been overly generous is dropping him just 3lb for those heavy defeats, but unwise to put a line through him.

runners.comment: Free-going front-runner; faded into third on soft at Cheltenham latest but still ran well
runners.name: Javert Allen
runners.spotlight: Free-going front-runner who was a little too keen for his own good when weakening into a 10l third at Cheltenham four weeks ago (2m4f, soft); the ground might not be quite so slow this afternoon and that would help him; respected.

runners.comment: On a tempting mark with Harry Atkins taking off 7lb if she was on her game
runners.name: Shakeyatailfeather
runners.spotlight: Has done all her winning on good ground so any rain would be a negative, which counted against her in a Listed chase for mares last time; on a tempting mark with Harry Atkins taking off 7lb if she was on her game (wasn't the case the time before at Ascot).

16:40.race_name: Ladbrokes "Best Odds Guaranteed On Racing" Open National Hunt Flat Race (Cat 1 Elimination) (GBB)

runners.comment: Overcame greenness to win nine-runner race at Sandown; respected under a penalty
runners.name: Le Roi Remi
runners.spotlight: Overcame greenness to win nine-runner race at Sandown (good to soft; 12-1) in November, forging clear after briefly losing place 4f out; open to improvement and respected under a penalty.

runners.comment: Followed a Hereford win with a good second at Warwick; yard won this race in 2021 and 2025
runners.name: Smile John Boy
runners.spotlight: Made all at Hereford (good) in November and stepped up on that form when second at Warwick (good to soft; raced freely) on New Year's Eve; capable of better still and his stable won this race in 2021 and 2025.

runners.comment: Unplaced at Wincanton and Exeter towards the end of 2025; others appeal more
runners.name: Baile An Or
runners.owner: M-A Middleton J Perry K Phillips
runners.spotlight: Unplaced at Wincanton (good) and Exeter (soft) towards the end of 2025; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Shaped nicely when third at Huntingdon last February; that form has worked out quite well
runners.name: Fine Shot
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen
runners.spotlight: Home-bred who shaped nicely when third of 11 at Huntingdon (good to soft; 12-1) over a year ago, rallying after being outpaced; that form has worked out quite well; should do better if ready to roll after an absence.

runners.comment: Third in two points and every chance when falling last on latest; interesting contender
runners.name: Jambon
runners.spotlight: Third in first two points in Ireland, and he had every chance when falling at the last on latest outing in November; new stable does well in this sphere; interesting contender, especially if the market speaks in his favour.

runners.breeder: S C P Ecurie Pegase & Joelle Brillet
runners.comment: Best work late on when second to Smile John Boy at Hereford; has to be considered
runners.name: Ma Wang Des Bois
runners.owner: S Foran N Turner & E Fenton
runners.spotlight: Did his best work late on when second to Smile John Boy at Hereford (good; 12-1) three months ago, and he meets that rival on 5lb better terms; Harry Cobden again takes the ride; has to be considered.

runners.comment: Bred for longer trips but made nice start when second at Huntingdon; should progress
runners.name: Oties Friend
runners.spotlight: Bred to be suited by longer distances in due course but he made an encouraging start when 3l second of eight at Huntingdon (good to soft; 4-1) just before Christmas, keeping on from the rear; likely to progress.

runners.comment: 1-1 in Irish points and the runner-up has since won a Leopardstown bumper; respected
runners.name: Rattlin Home
runners.spotlight: Won an Irish point (good/yielding) in October and the runner-up gave that form a boost by making a winning rules debut in a bumper at Leopardstown on Boxing Day; new stable has an excellent record (21% this season) in this sphere; much respected, especially if strong in the market.

runners.breeder: A McGladdery Ka Bloodstock & S Kemble
runners.comment: £75,000 3yo; by Walk In The Park; yard is 12% in bumpers in last five seasons
runners.name: Spanish Stroll
runners.spotlight: £75,000 3yo; by Walk In The Park; dam bumper/2m hurdle winner, half-sister to AQPS Flat winners Solenne Du Clos (1m4f) and Alyse Du Clos (11.5f); one of two runners for Joe Tizzard (12% in bumpers last five seasons).

runners.comment: Disappointing latest but previously second in Listed race; possibilities if bouncing back
runners.name: Tally Ho Back
runners.spotlight: Disappointing last of six when favourite at Windsor five weeks ago, but he'd previously shown a useful level of form when second in Listed event at Ascot (soft); has real possibilities if bouncing back.

runners.comment: Beat 11 opponents handsomely at Aintree in November, quickening; may well follow up
runners.name: Merlin Allen
runners.spotlight: Has an appealing pedigree and beat 11 opponents handsomely at Aintree (good to soft; 6-1) in November, quickening well from midfield; returns from 105 days off with yard in fine form; may well follow up.

runners.comment: Cosy winner at Hereford in December, pulling clear with runner-up; one more to consider
runners.name: Red Metal
runners.spotlight: Led 3f out and comfortably held on at Hereford in December, pulling clear with the runner-up; open to improvement and is one more to consider.

runners.comment: By Elm Park; stable has the odd bumper winner so worth a look in the market
runners.name: Equi Libre
runners.spotlight: By Elm Park; dam placed French 1m7f/2m1f hurdles, closely related to 5f 2yo winner Exceeder; stable has the odd bumper winner so worth a look in the market.

runners.comment: Tailed off at Cheltenham on New Year's Day; looks the stable's second string
runners.name: Maestrow
runners.spotlight: Weak in the market and tailed off at Cheltenham on New Year's Day; looks the stable's second string.

runners.comment: Smart AW sprinter; dead-heated in 6f Listed here last month; major player despite penalty
runners.name: Diligent Harry
runners.spotlight: Smart on turf but AW is his thing and he added another Listed win to his tally when dead-heating in the Kachy Stakes (6f) here three weeks ago; has a penalty to shoulder but that was also the case when he won the corresponding race in 2024 (run at Southwell); a lower draw would have been preferable but he looks set to go well again.

runners.comment: Fast sprinter who has a good C&D record; big personal best required at this level
runners.name: Clearpoint
runners.spotlight: Better than ever in late 2025, winning two C&D handicaps before completing his hat-trick at Wolverhampton in November; ran as well as he ever has when second over C&D in December but that defeat off a BHA mark of 96 will need bettering to trouble the principals.

runners.comment: Front-runner; capable of smart form on his day; shouldn't be underestimated
runners.name: Democracy Dilemma
runners.spotlight: Not at his best at Beverley when last seen in September but his earlier Haydock win was a fine handicap performance; trip to Dubai ended unceremoniously when he got upset in the stalls before a Group 2 assignment; shouldn't be underestimated with Tom Marquand a positive booking for the yard.

runners.comment: Prolific at Dundalk and won easily over 5f a fortnight ago; third in this race last year
runners.name: Valiant Force
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar
runners.spotlight: Good record on the AW track at Dundalk and he was well in command at the finish against three inferior opponents two weeks ago (5f); creditable third in this race 12 months ago (run at Southwell); more needed today.

runners.comment: Well-beaten 66-1 shot on last month's British debut; can't recommend on the back of that
runners.name: Golden Sickle
runners.spotlight: Multiple 5f winner in South Africa; second in a Group 1 at Turffontein last March; 66-1 and well beaten behind Diligent Harry on British debut here three weeks ago; can't recommend on the back of that.

runners.comment: Group 2 winner at Royal Ascot as a 2yo; promise in one run in 2025; tongue tied for return
runners.name: Leovanni
runners.spotlight: Impressed at Nottingham on her 2yo debut and went on to defeat 23 rivals in the Queen Mary Stakes a fortnight later; only seen three times since, once last year when not getting a clear run through in a Haydock Listed race in May; could still dip into that 2yo promise and AW shouldn't be an issue; tongue tied for the first time.

runners.comment: Fine effort to make all in the Cambridgeshire off top weight when last seen; considered
runners.name: Boiling Point
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; second in a Group 3 at last year's Ebor meeting before producing a high-class effort to make all and defy top-weight in the Cambridgeshire (1m1f, good to firm); promise in his one AW start; up in trip for his reappearance but some encouragement for it on the dam's side of his pedigree; represents last year's winning connections.

runners.comment: Improving 4yo; won in spite of hanging left at Southwell latest; seems likely to stay
runners.name: Chancellor
runners.spotlight: On the up since gelding and wind ops last summer, winning a Kempton handicap in November and adding a Southwell Listed race two weeks ago; hung left across the track in the closing stages at Southwell but still comfortably on top at the finish; looks classy enough for this company and there is encouragement for 1m2f on pedigree (dam a Grade 1 winner at the trip); one of two solid contenders for a stable with a fine record in the race.

runners.comment: Not found his best form for current stable; others arrive with less to prove
runners.name: Military Academy
runners.spotlight: Former stablemate of Chancellor and Nebras who finished second in this race last year (run at Southwell over 1m3f); visored in three runs for new connections and he hasn't been near his best; change of headgear but looks up against it once more.

runners.comment: Game effort to win a steadily-run Listed event over C&D in December; improving 4yo; chance
runners.name: Nebras
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a pair of 1m2f wins on AW, the latest a Listed race where he enjoyed the run of things but showed a fine attitude to repel a solid yardstick; unlikely to enjoy such a soft time through the early part of this race but he is an improving 4yo and Ryan Moore is booked.

runners.comment: Fine record on AW and latest C&D second another step forward; shouldn't be underestimated
runners.name: Sky Safari
runners.spotlight: Tasted defeat on AW for the first time when second of ten, beaten a head, in a good fillies' handicap over C&D five weeks ago; beaten by a good filly, rather than the trip, on that occasion and she is still improving; shouldn't be underestimated.

14:33.race_name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap

runners.comment: Things didn't go his way in a tactical race last time and he's in the mix back up in trip
runners.name: Charlies Choice
runners.spotlight: Clearcut win at Lingfield (1m4f) last month and he went close on his return visit seven days later; didn't fire at Wolverhampton (9.4f) last time but that was a tactical race and he still looks on a workable mark; in the mix back up in trip.

runners.comment: Off the mark when beating a clear second at Chelmsford last month; big player again up 4lb
runners.name: Relocal
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt when finishing well to land a Chelmsford handicap (1m5f; second-time blinkers) last month; up 4lb for that narrow success but he pulled clear with the runner-up and is open to more progress at this sort of trip; key player.

runners.breeder: Lofts Hall Stud B Sangster New England
runners.comment: Won twice this winter but he's taken backward steps in his last two starts; risks attached
runners.name: Tortured Soul
runners.spotlight: Gained narrow wins at Lingfield (1m2f, Polytrack) and Southwell (1m3f, Tapeta) this winter but he's taken two backward steps since his last success; now goes back up in trip but he's not easy to predict and others are more persuasive.

runners.comment: Returned to the Flat with two fair efforts at Wolverhampton; dangerous back in trip
runners.name: Market House
runners.spotlight: Four wins, with three on the Flat (1m4f) and one over hurdles (2m3f); out of sorts in last three hurdle runs but he's returned to the Flat with two respectable efforts at Wolverhampton (9.4f/2m) this winter; should go well again on this drop back in trip and he's in the mix for in-form yard.

runners.comment: 0-9 but he's on a dangerous mark and hasn't been with James Owen for long; market useful
runners.name: Sword Of Wessex
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden but he's well treated on his best form for Charlie Fellowes and may have needed the run on stable debut at Newcastle (1m2f) last month; should be sharper this time and he needs watching in market back up in trip; cheekpieces reapplied.

runners.comment: Six turf wins but he's 0-5 on AW and has been well held at Kempton last twice
runners.name: Lusaka
runners.spotlight: Six-time turf winner but he's 0-5 on AW and has been well held at Kempton (2m, Polytrack) in last two runs; bit to prove but a return to positive tactics could help and his last win was over 1m5f; reapplied cheekpieces replace blinkers; stablemate of Risen Again.

runners.comment: Record is 1-20 but he needs checking in market on return for new yard; hood removed
runners.name: Risen Again
runners.spotlight: Record is 1-20 but he had some close calls on turf (1m1f) and Polytrack (1m2f) towards the end of last summer; left Alice Haynes for 17,000gns in October; now tackles a new trip for a new yard but he needs watching in market on his return; hood removed.

runners.comment: Well held in three hurdle runs for current yard and has bit to prove back on the Flat
runners.name: Green Sky
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish mare who has been well held over hurdles in three runs for her current yard; won on the Flat as a 3yo but her last run in this sphere was almost two years ago and others are preferred.

runners.comment: Won at Southwell last month but he's not gone on from that in two runs since
runners.name: Prince Quattro
runners.owner: Ursa Major Ltd & Hicky Parmar Racing
runners.spotlight: Gained his first Flat win when digging deep in a 1m6f handicap at Southwell last month; ran to a similar level when third at Wolverhampton next time but his form cooled at that track 18 days ago; needs to step up again after that and he's now 1-13 in this sphere.

runners.comment: Bounced back with a win here last month and that form has been boosted since; respected
runners.name: Hebridean Nomad
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he justified support when bouncing back with a strong-finishing win here (1m4f) last month; up 4lb but that was a cosy success and the form has been boosted by the runner-up since; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Disappointing since his last win in July and he needs to find more back in trip
runners.name: Green Team
runners.spotlight: Won off 3lb higher at Thirsk (1m6f, good to soft) last July but he's been disappointing since; had some traffic issues at Wolverhampton (2m) last time but he needs to find more back at this trip; cheekpieces reapplied.

runners.comment: Has struggled in both runs this winter and he needs a major revival back at this trip
runners.name: Haaland
runners.spotlight: Three AW wins (1m2f-2m) in 2023; lightly raced since and he's been well held back from another break in his two runs this winter; mark continues to fall but he needs a major revival back at this trip.

runners.comment: Back from layoff with two close calls this winter (1m4f/1m3f) and he's strongly respected
runners.name: Paradias
runners.spotlight: Building up a consistent AW record that features two wins last winter and a creditable effort at Newcastle on finals day; returned from a layoff with good second at Wolverhampton (1m4f) in December and he had another close call at Kempton (1m3f) last month; just 1lb higher than for that last run and he's strongly respected back up in trip.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 6yo who was well held on his stable/AW debut last month; others preferred
runners.name: Shadow Dance
runners.spotlight: On same mark as for his win at York (1m4f, good) in August 2024 but he's not seen much action since and has been well held in last four starts; may have needed the run on his stable/AW debut at Kempton (28-1) last month but others are more persuasive.

runners.comment: Back from almost two years off with a win at Wolverhampton two weeks ago; respected up 3lb
runners.name: Nolton Cross
runners.spotlight: 7yo who returned after almost two years off with a game win over 1m4f at Wolverhampton (12-1) two weeks ago; 3lb higher on this step back up in grade but he wasn't far off his best last time and he's now 6-21 on AW; dangerous.

runners.comment: Second in a Listed hurdle event when last seen in October; needs a close look on return
runners.name: Ammes
runners.spotlight: Did well switched to hurdling in the autumn, with two wins followed by a close second in a Listed juvenile event at Wetherby; record of 1-8 in this sphere but he's been reliable and was placed off this mark in his last Flat run (11.4f); yard has been firing in winners recently and he needs a close look on his return.

runners.comment: Five-time turf winner but he's 0-8 on AW and has struggled in both runs this winter
runners.name: Night Breeze
runners.spotlight: Ended his 2025 campaign with a win on Shergar Cup day at Ascot but he's struggled back on AW in his two runs this winter; has plenty to prove again and he's now 0-8 in this sphere.

runners.comment: Haydock winner who made solid start in handicaps in the autumn; interesting on his return
runners.name: Respond
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who won a Haydock maiden (1m2f, good) last August; took a strong hold in two handicaps in the autumn but he was beaten less 2l on both occasions including when an eyecatching fifth at Newmarket (1m4f) last time; still has potential and he's an interesting contender back from a break.

runners.comment: Four wins since October but this is a big step up in grade and he's untried at this trip
runners.name: Towerlands
runners.spotlight: Big improver who has won four of his last six starts, including a comfortable success at Wolverhampton (9.4f) 18 days ago; still looks feasibly treated off 5lb higher than for that success but this is a big step up in grade and he's untried at this trip.

runners.comment: Second in three bumpers in early 2025; no impact in two 1m Kempton maidens this year
runners.name: Naval Tribute
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in three bumpers in early 2025; no impact in two 1m maidens at Kempton since switched to the Flat; middle-distance handicaps more suitable after this.

runners.comment: 36,000gns half-brother to a Listed winner out of a Listed winner; looks the part on paper
runners.name: Al Maslool
runners.spotlight: 36,000gns foal; fourth foal; half-brother to US 1m/8.5f turf winner Oversubscribed (including Listed; RPR 107); dam 7f/1m winner (including AW/2yo/Listed; 109); of obvious appeal on paper.

runners.comment: RPR of 61 in two runs this year; sold 11,000gns since latest; up in trip with more needed
runners.name: Bennyworth
runners.spotlight: Made his debut in a good race here last month (7f) and ended up well beaten; similar form over 6f at Newcastle 17 days ago (wore cheekpieces, absent today); sold for 11,000gns since; should do better at some point but handicaps should provide easier pickings in time.

runners.comment: Some promise in his two starts this year but improvement essential if he is to take this
runners.name: Dakota Breeze
runners.spotlight: Debut second came in a modest affair at Newcastle (7f); no improvement for a mile at Southwell two weeks ago; improvement essential.

runners.comment: First foal of a 1m winner (RPR 95) from a good family; market support significant
runners.name: El Nay
runners.spotlight: First foal of a 1m winner (RPR 95), herself from the family of 1,000 Guineas winner Natagora; likely type on paper and he is one to note for market confidence.

runners.comment: Last month's Dundalk debut (10.6f) wasn't without hope; not discounted on stable debut
runners.name: Ghaiyyath Deer
runners.spotlight: Sent off the 4-1 joint second favourite for a 10.6f maiden at Dundalk 24 days ago and showed some promise amidst inexperience; has since left Dermot Weld (same owner); open to improvement and may prove the best of those with racecourse experience.

runners.comment: 200,000gns half-brother to 4 winners; entered in Irish 2,000 Guineas; betting instructive
runners.name: Sin City
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns yearling; seventh foal; half-brother to winners Excel Power (6f-1m including AW; RPR 108), Caspian Queen (Group-placed 5f-7f including AW; 96), Barging Thru (5f-7f AW including 2yo/France; 91) and Our Melody (5f AW; 64); Irish 2,000 Guineas entrant; betting should be informative.

runners.comment: 580,000euros yearling; dam unraced sister to three Group 1 winners; likely type on paper
runners.name: Turret
runners.spotlight: 580,000euros yearling; second foal of an unraced sister to Group 1 winners Hydrangea (1m/1m4f), The United States (Australian 1m2f) and Hermosa (1,000 Guineas/Irish 1,000 Guineas); of obvious interest on paper for a stable in good order.

runners.comment: Second at Chelmsford (6f) last October before 10,000gns sale; has to prove stamina for 1m
runners.name: Bellini Spirit
runners.spotlight: Confirmed promise of her Chelmsford debut (7f) last September by finishing second in a 6f maiden back at Chelmsford one month later; sold for 10,000gns since; form is up there with the best of that on show but she has to prove her stamina and there are some intriguing newcomers in opposition.

runners.comment: Unplaced in two runs last month; minor handicaps more suitable after this
runners.name: Pangbourne
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in two runs last month; minor handicaps more suitable after this.

runners.comment: Two 7f wins at Chelmsford this year; good 3rd at Kempton latest; in the mix once again

runners.spotlight: Two 7f wins at Chelmsford this year and he ran right up to his best when third of nine at Kempton ten days ago; no obvious reason why he wouldn't make another bold bid.

runners.comment: C&D winner; comes here on the back of two good second-place finishes; contender
runners.name: Antiquity
runners.owner: P&h Moorhead J Collins And S Piper
runners.spotlight: Three wins in the first half of 2025, including over C&D; runner-up on his last two starts and likely to be in the shake-up again.

runners.comment: Dropping down the weights but two handicap runs this winter have yielded heavy defeats
runners.name: Kev
runners.spotlight: Promise last winter; absent for 328 days prior to his Kempton reappearance in December; well beaten there, and again last month, and he is risky despite his reduced mark.

runners.comment: Three course wins this winter; not at best last time but return to this track can help
runners.name: Poke The Bear
runners.spotlight: On the up this winter, winning three handicaps at the track (two over this trip and one over 7f); below par at Wolverhampton two weeks ago but could prove a different proposition back here.

runners.comment: No better than midfield in 2 course handicaps last month; down 7lb but needs to raise game
runners.name: Dodging The Bullet
runners.spotlight: Promise here in his maiden runs but no better than midfield in two handicaps last month (1m2f and 1m); dropped 7lb but others have more pressing claims.

runners.comment: Promise over C&D on debut; well beaten over 1m2f twice after; interesting h'cap debutante
runners.name: Phyllis Burton
runners.spotlight: Encouraging debut over C&D last April; two heavy defeats over 1m2f followed; not obviously thrown in for her handicap debut/return from eight-month absence but Rossa Ryan is booked and she needs a close market check.

runners.comment: Placed on last three starts (including stable debut on Monday); stamina for 1m not assured
runners.name: Ardaddy
runners.spotlight: 7f win at Southwell last October; two good placed efforts for Grant Tuer last month and he was a good third on his stable debut on Monday (6f); on a competitive mark but he does have his stamina to prove at a mile.

runners.comment: Well placed in tactical 1m2f event here a fortnight ago; up 2lb and others look stronger
runners.name: Danehill Star
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways when making most in a small-field 1m2f handicap here two weeks ago; only 2lb higher but unlikely that this will pan out so smoothly.

runners.comment: Minor form in two handicap runs last month; new blinkers not enough to tempt
runners.name: Hopjes
runners.spotlight: Neither run last month (1m3f and 1m) suggested he was ready to break his duck; down 7lb but needs new blinkers to have a transformative effect.

runners.comment: Good front-running effort at Newcastle on Sunday (1m); respected back in handicap
runners.name: Sold Out
runners.spotlight: Taken a while to get the hang of racing but he is on the up now, following a close fourth at Wolverhampton with a breakthrough success at Newcastle on Sunday (1m); a reproduction would see him bang there under his penalty.

17:00.race_name: Midnite, Building The Future Of Betting Handicap

runners.comment: Several good runs since her Kempton win last summer; should be involved once again
runners.name: Corniche Girl
runners.owner: C Munro Mrs M Gander And Partner
runners.spotlight: 6f win at Kempton last summer; several good runs in defeat since, including upped to 1m here last week, and unlikely to be far away off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Beaten at short odds in both handicap runs this year; remains capable of better; contender
runners.name: Marra Donna
runners.spotlight: Warm favourite for both handicap runs this month but he has managed only third on each occasion; leaves the impression he has a bigger effort in him when things pan out more favourably; high on the list.

runners.comment: Hood could help her settle but recent stable/handicap debut needs bettering
runners.name: Denbys Dream
runners.spotlight: Raced freely and caught out wide on her recent handicap/stable debut (7f), beaten 9.5l at the finish; now hooded; improvement essential.

runners.comment: Bath maiden win for former yard but little impact in handicaps since; enough to prove
runners.name: Runamara
runners.spotlight: 5.7f maiden win for Kevin Philippart de Foy in September; struggled in handicaps since, including on last month's stable debut.

runners.comment: Kempton win last month franked; perhaps stretched by 7f latest; each-way shout
runners.name: Madman
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 11th attempt when readily seeing off a filly that has won twice since at Kempton last month; perhaps stretched by 7f at Wolverhampton two weeks ago and he holds each-way claims back at 6f.

runners.comment: Makes handicap/stable debut after four months off; not bred to sprint but best run over 6f
runners.name: Laser Luck
runners.spotlight: Modest form in three runs for Brian Toomey in the second half of 2025 (best effort over 6f); not bred to sprint and although she has potential for her new yard (sold 6,000gns in October), this may not be her day.

runners.comment: Down in the weights but likely to remain vulnerable to less-exposed rivals
runners.name: Mister Moet
runners.spotlight: Dropping down the weights and there has been the odd good run for new connections this winter; vulnerable to less-exposed rivals.

runners.comment: In good order since handicapping this winter but she will need a career best to take this
runners.name: Rosieisme Darling
runners.spotlight: 5f win at Chelmsford in December; in the frame in three starts since but others could have her measure this time.

runners.comment: 0-8; dropping down the weights but others appeal more for win purposes
runners.name: Real Gold
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; dropping down the weights but still hard to say she was ahead of her mark.

13:05.race_name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Finished placed in two Irish points and he needs watching in market on hurdling debut
runners.name: Argento Royale
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to two hurdle winners and he showed some promise with his two placed efforts in Irish points (2m4f/3m) last spring; tongue-tie is now added on rules debut but he needs checking in market on comeback.
