runners.comment: Promise in two Irish bumpers but nothing like so good in three runs for current yard
runners.name: Au Plaisir
runners.spotlight: Definite promise in two Irish bumpers but nothing like so good in a bumper and two hurdle runs for current yard.

runners.comment: Well held in both hurdle runs and will be more interesting when switched to handicaps
runners.name: Ayyadieh
runners.spotlight: Well held in both Irish points last spring and same story in two hurdle runs (2m1f/1m7f) this winter; has quite a bit to find on the figures and wlll be of greater interest when switched to handicaps.

runners.comment: Well beaten in two bumpers and he's struggled at massive prices in both hurdle runs
runners.name: Blazing Echo
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers and he's struggled at massive prices in two hurdle runs this year, including over C&D.

runners.comment: Showed promise in a bumper here in December and needs checking in market on hurdling debut
runners.name: Flaming Norman
runners.spotlight: Dam unraced half-sister to Grand National second Pleasant Company; well beaten on bumper debut in November but he showed some promise when fourth of 11 here (2m1f, good to soft) the following month; may ideally want a stiffer stamina test over jumps but he needs checking in market on hurdling debut.

runners.breeder: S C E A Haras De LEtoile & P Matzinger
runners.comment: Bumper winner who has been placed in two novice hurdles at Kempton; key player
runners.name: Jimbo Sport
runners.spotlight: In the frame in three points before making all in Hereford bumper in March; held in two hurdle runs at Kempton (2m, good) since but he went close in the first one and his latest third was behind a smart prospect on Boxing Day; sets a fair standard on that latest effort and he's a big player for in-form yard.

runners.comment: Irish point winner but he's struggled in both hurdle runs for current yard
runners.name: Jonzac
runners.spotlight: Bought for 25,000euros after his Irish point win in November but he's struggled in two hurdle runs for new yard since; still early days in this sphere but he needs a transformation.

runners.comment: In the frame in both hurdle runs and was only beaten 5l at Carlisle last time; in the mix
runners.name: Karma De Cotte
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish point in October; well held in sole bumper in December but he's reached the frame in two hurdle runs this year and was only beaten 5l at Carlisle (2m1f, good to soft) last time; could continue to progress in this sphere and he's in the mix.

runners.comment: Reached the frame in two hurdle runs at Ayr and he's respected with tongue-tie added
runners.name: Like Minded
runners.spotlight: Made a solid start when fourth in an Ayr novice (2m, heavy) in December and he confirmed that promise with his creditable third there (beaten less than 4l) last month; that form puts him firmly in the picture and he's respected with tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: Tailed off on bumper debut at Ayr last month and needs to leave that form miles behind
runners.name: Melbourne Ghost
runners.spotlight: Brother to two hurdle winners but he was tailed off in a bumper at Ayr (2m, heavy) last month and needs to leave that form miles behind.

runners.comment: Unplaced in four Flat runs this winter and needs plenty of improvement on hurdling debut
runners.name: Ned Broy
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in four Flat runs on Tapeta this winter and latest was on handicap debut here (1m2f) last month; hasn't progressed in that sphere and he needs plenty of improvement on this switch to hurdling.

runners.comment: Third on hurdling debut at Southwell but he was tailed off at Kelso last Friday
runners.name: Nosy Neighbour
runners.spotlight: Showed ability when 19l third on hurdle debut at Southwell (2m, good to soft) in November but he was tailed off at Kelso (2m, heavy) last Friday; has bit to prove after that and his pedigree suggests he'll come into his own over further.

runners.comment: Sold for £80,000 after his point win but he's struggled in his first two runs under rules
runners.name: Valtteri Its James
runners.spotlight: Won Irish maiden point by 8l in November and sold for £80,000 12 days later; things should click under rules at some point but he struggled in a bumper here (good to soft) last month and was beaten 36l when switched to hurdling at Ayr (2m, soft) last time; stablemate of Like Minded.

runners.comment: Well held in sole bumper and same story on recent hurdling debut at Carlisle; opposable
runners.name: Bollin Skittle
runners.spotlight: Well-held fifth of six in her sole bumper and she beat only one rival again on recent hurdling debut at Carlisle (2m3f, good to soft); passed over.

runners.comment: Needs to step up but this half-brother to Cloth Cap is now raised in distance
runners.name: Unleash The Beast
runners.spotlight: 0-6; well held in two handicaps and the writing was on the wall a long way out on his return at Chepstow; what could help is this longer trip with him a half-brother to smart staying chaser Cloth Cap.

runners.comment: Has mostly struggled since winning off a higher mark at Kelso 11 months ago
runners.name: Starlyte
runners.spotlight: Has mostly struggled since winning off a higher mark at Kelso 11 months ago (2m5f, good to soft) and now returns from 99 days off.

runners.comment: 2m Flat winner; modest so far over hurdles but now makes his handicap debut
runners.name: Cold Henry
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner (at 2m) who hasn't offered a lot so far over hurdles but now makes his handicap debut; wouldn't rule out given Flat ability.

runners.comment: Uncompetitive in three handicaps and looks risky with blinkers on for cheekpieces
runners.name: Justus
runners.spotlight: Four-time Flat winner and has won a novice hurdle; uncompetitive in three handicaps and looks risky with blinkers on for cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Making handicap debut but hasn't offered enough in his qualifying races
runners.name: Sparky Tom
runners.spotlight: Making handicap debut but hasn't offered enough in his qualifying races; only of interest if backed.

runners.comment: Has found his level in handicaps, with four competitive shows at about 2m4f
runners.name: Drop Kick
runners.spotlight: Has found his level in handicaps, with four competitive shows at about 2m4f; beaten only a neck in a big field here last time (good to soft; fine on softer); edging up the weights but more solid than many of these.

runners.comment: Dual C&D winner; not far away again here last month after a wind operation
runners.name: Our Laura B
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been over C&D and she wasn't beaten far into third back here last month after a wind operation; definite chance if building on that.

runners.comment: Pulled up in three of his four races this season; didn't look easy ride when he completed
runners.name: Eire Street
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in three of his four races this season and didn't look an easy ride when he completed.

runners.comment: Won on stable debut at Sedgefield and that was after a similar absence; up 4lb
runners.name: Top Flight Century
runners.spotlight: Back from a break to make successful yard debut at Sedgefield (2m4f, good to soft) and now returns from a similar absence off 4lb higher; should run well.

runners.comment: This point winner was always likely to fare better in handicaps; best to let market guide
runners.name: Mooserwirt
runners.spotlight: Beaten 24l+ in 2m-2m4f hurdle races but this Irish point winner was always likely to fare better in handicaps; best to let the market guide.

runners.comment: Second at Catterick was encouraging and 3m looked too far on heavy last time
runners.name: Holly Bird
runners.spotlight: Responded well to first-time cheekpieces when second at Catterick (2m3f, good to soft) and didn't appear to stay 3m on heavy ground at Ayr; did run well to a point and Brian Hughes rides again.

runners.comment: On a good mark and stopped the rot when beaten 5l in first-time cheekpieces at Wetherby
runners.name: Glory Hights
runners.spotlight: Only previous win was over 3m but off this mark; stopped the rot when beaten 5l in first-time cheekpieces at Wetherby and he's effective at this trip.

runners.comment: Pulled up on chase debut in December and has offered nothing back over hurdles
runners.name: Sams Falcon
runners.spotlight: Hasn't had a lot of racing but was pulled up on chase debut in December and has offered nothing back over hurdles.

runners.comment: Has shown he can run well off this mark and less testing ground here could suit
runners.name: Wainwright
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 8yo; bled from the nose when pulled up on chasing debut in December (did go off favourite) but suffered the same fate on his return to hurdling, again on heavy; has shown he can run well off this mark and less testing ground here could suit; tries cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Now blinkered and did win 11 months ago when visored for the first time
runners.name: Boolamore Classic
runners.spotlight: Won an Ayr handicap 13 months ago when visored for the first time so there's hope that the new blinkers might have a similar effect; risky enough, though.

14:10.race_name: Jimmy Hunter 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Handicap Chase (Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Up to winning a race off this mark and stable has landed the past two renewals of this
runners.name: Spadestep
runners.spotlight: Point/novice hurdle winner; his second to Jordans Cross on chase debut at Aintree (2m, good) reads really well and, although yet to build on that, he's delivered another couple of solid efforts (heavy ground perhaps not ideal latest when behind The Grafter); can surely win a race off this mark and stable has landed the past two renewals of this.

runners.comment: Well backed when beating Spadestep on chase debut here on heavy; raised 8lb
runners.name: The Grafter
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in four handicap hurdles last season; heavy ground could have been a factor in him showing improved form on his successful chase debut over C&D last month, though was well backed prior to comfortably repelling Spadestep; 9lb worse off with the runner-up but clearly open to further improvement.

runners.comment: Dual chase winner this season and returning to a left-handed track should suit
runners.name: Sleeping Satellite
runners.spotlight: Winner on good ground over 2m3f at Stratford and Catterick this season; another fair effort when third of four at Musselburgh last time (2m4f, soft) where he jumped left on occasions; return to a left-handed track should suit and he can go well (won a bumper on soft ground).

runners.comment: Has another 6lb to contend with but very much heading the right way; 2-2 over fences
runners.name: Always A Reason
runners.owner: Miss Maria D Myco & John Johnson
runners.spotlight: Progressed well over hurdles; didn't appear to be doing a lot in front when just holding on to make it 2-2 over fences at Catterick (2m3f, soft; second run in cheekpieces); has another 6lb to contend with but very much heading the right way.

runners.comment: Shooting up the weights (raised another 8lb) but things have clicked in a big way
runners.name: Stick With Me Sam
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Jw Dale & & Mrs Jdj Copas
runners.spotlight: Has won three of his four races in this headgear combination and it was fairly comfortable at Catterick three weeks ago (1m7f, soft); shooting up the weights (raised another 8lb) but things have clicked in a big way.

runners.comment: Just about his best run yet under rules when beaten 10l on switch to fences at Ayr (2m4f)
runners.name: Ballyedward
runners.spotlight: Just about his best run yet under rules when beaten 10l on the switch to fences at Ayr (2m4f, soft); this is more competitive and it's questionable whether he wants the drop back to 2m.

runners.comment: Things have picked up over fences the last twice but this is competitive
runners.name: Galidam
runners.spotlight: Won a claiming hurdle in France (2m1f, soft) in September 2024; didn't show a great deal over hurdles for this yard but two fair efforts over fences and would have been closer last time without a mistake; this is competitive, though.

14:43.race_name: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Eider Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 4m2f Midlands National winner; ran badly on latest start but this is a much better fit
runners.name: Mr Vango
runners.spotlight: Hugely the class act in this field and last season's hat-trick culminated in the 4m2f Midlands National; rallied to go very close in the Becher at Aintree (3m2f) on first outing this season; he wasn't going almost immediately once headed (fairly early stage) last time, which is a nagging worry despite that race being over just 3m; soft or heavy ground is ideal but there's no doubting his strength in stamina and that factor is key.

runners.comment: Won this in 2024 off 4lb lower; first run for new yard was a sparkling win in November
runners.name: Anglers Crag
runners.spotlight: The final leg of his four-timer for Brian Ellison two winters back was this race off 4lb lower than today; never fired on all cylinders last term but reappeared for new yard in November with a sparkling win, employing new tactics as he made all at Carlisle to come home 9l clear; back up 8lb, so needs to be back at his very best, but he's one for the shortlist.

runners.comment: Below form latest; pulled up both attempts at about 3m5f/3m6f, admittedly two winters back
runners.name: Only The Bold
runners.spotlight: Staged a major revival last May/June and finished well for close third in veterans' event at Sandown (3m) in November, but not so good on latest start; pulled up on both attempts at about 3m5f/3m6f, admittedly two winters back but a stronger promise of stamina would be preferred.

runners.comment: Won the 2024 Welsh National off 3lb lower; ran creditably penultimate start, not on latest
runners.name: Val Dancer
runners.spotlight: Won last season's Welsh National (extended 3m6f, soft) off 3lb lower and second in the Grand National Trial at Haydock; near that form on second start this term, before a lesser show (weak in the market) in the Surrey National at Lingfield; needs to be back at his peak and there are mixed messages.

runners.comment: Strong-finishing win here (3m6f, good to soft) and he was also sixth in the Welsh National
runners.name: Dom Of Mary
runners.spotlight: Trained by David Bridgwater to win the 2024 Sussex National at Plumpton and nearly win it last term, both on soft; has made a solid start for James Owen this term, notably with a strong-finishing win here (3m6f, good to soft) but he was also sixth in the Welsh National last time; each-way player.

runners.comment: Made all in Southern National; creditable fourth in the Welsh National (extended 3m6f)
runners.name: Livin On Luco
runners.spotlight: Made all under Callum Pritchard in the Southern National at Fontwell (extended 3m3f, good to soft) on reappearance in November, clear from four out and holding on by a neck from a strong finisher; came from mid-division when creditable fourth in the Welsh National at Chepstow (extended 3m6f) and having a crack at 4m+ now makes appeal; one to consider.

runners.comment: Disappointing latest; earlier signals, including at 3m4f, make him a plausible candidate
runners.name: Fortunate Man
runners.spotlight: Second-season chaser who was hot favourite at Sandown three weeks ago but disappointing in third behind the runaway winner; however, that followed a winning reappearance at Aintree (3m1f, good to soft) on Boxing Day and last season's positive signals included his second over 3m4f at Windsor (soft) on his only attempt beyond 3m1f; those make him a plausible candidate.

runners.comment: Wind op since latest start; tongue tied first time; 9lb below last winter's peak mark
runners.name: Whistle Stop Tour
runners.owner: Mrs Jo Tracey K Alexander P&S Bryceland
runners.spotlight: Wore cheekpieces on last four starts, to be placed twice over hurdles but not faring so well in two chases, including behind Val Dancer at Lingfield (upped markedly to 3m5f) last time; given wind surgery since and now has tongue tied first time; he's now 9lb below last winter's peak mark (even from out of the handicap) so has his chance if back on song.

runners.comment: 11lb higher than for Lincolnshire National win but he's a strong candidate for this trip
runners.name: Red Delta
runners.spotlight: 3-10 in points; seven-race career under rules includes two handicap wins this season and there have been two notable performances over 3m3f/3m4f, including his win in the Lincolnshire National at Market Rasen (good to soft) on Boxing Day last time; 11lb higher this time (including 3lb out of the handicap) but he's a strong candidate for this trip.

runners.comment: Hacked up in this in 2025; well in if back to that form and stranger things have happened
runners.name: Knockanore
runners.spotlight: Stormed clear for a 16l win under Freddie Mitchell in this race last year, form which has not been seen from him before or since but his last three outings were over hurdles; 11lb higher (10lb out of the handicap) than 12 months ago but well treated if he returns to that peak form and stranger things have happened.

15:20.race_name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: 3-6 over hurdles; better than he showed at Kelso latest but surprising to see him at 2m1f
runners.name: Baratablet
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-5 over hurdles with a comfortable 2m4f win here in December but off this 7lb higher mark he was never on an even keel when fourth at Kelso (2m6f); perhaps the track didn't help and, while it's surprising to see him back at 2m1f, he's a respected runner.

runners.comment: Second on chase debut in October; back with Nicky Richards and returned to hurdling
runners.name: Saracen Beau
runners.spotlight: Unexposed novice hurdle winner (2m, good to soft) late in 2024; runner-up on his handicap/chase debut at Bangor (2m4f, good) in October on his second run for the Russell/Scudamore stable; returns after another break but he's only 1lb higher than last time and is an interesting contender back over hurdles; has rejoined Nicky Richards.

runners.comment: Something to prove over quite this sharp a trip but definite chance if copes with it
runners.name: The Gray Ghost
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden here over 2m4f; a number of good runs in handicaps and 3m looked a stretch in a Class 2 at Musselburgh last time; something to prove over quite this sharp a trip but definite chance if he copes with it.

runners.comment: Unexposed maiden winner; hard to assess and the market could be instructive
runners.name: Seaview Rock
runners.spotlight: Unexposed handicap debutant from a top yard and he comfortably shed his maiden status at Leicester (1m7f, heavy); not the easiest to assess and the betting could be instructive.

runners.breeder: Mrs A L Merry & Mr Brett Merry
runners.comment: Beaten about 10l into fourth last time at Sedgefield and this is no easier
runners.name: Fromheretoeternity
runners.spotlight: Consistent but exposed and this mare remains on a fairly tough mark; beaten about 10l into fourth last time at Sedgefield and this is no easier.

runners.comment: Dual winner; only sixth at Carlisle latest and this is a stronger race than that day
runners.name: That One
runners.spotlight: Won twice last year and encouraging second back from a break at Carlisle (2m1f, soft); similar effort according to the figures despite finishing sixth back there 18 days ago; this is a stronger race than that day, though.

runners.comment: It's been hard work back over hurdles, albeit in a pair of Class 2 handicaps
runners.name: Cormier
runners.spotlight: Remains capable at the age of 10 (won on the Flat in October) but it's been hard work back over hurdles, albeit in a pair of Class 2 handicaps; looks vulnerable.

runners.comment: Handicap debut was underwhelming but that was over 2m4f and perhaps this is his trip
runners.name: The Hatchet
runners.spotlight: In two 2m novices he won at Perth before a rallying third at Ayr; handicap debut was underwhelming but that was over 2m4f and perhaps this is his trip.

runners.comment: Has shown enough in his hurdle races to believe he can make a mark in handicaps
runners.name: Party In The Park
runners.spotlight: Ran well in a bumper here and has shown enough in his hurdle races to believe he can make a mark in handicaps; not that this is the easiest of starters.

runners.comment: Right out of form in his last three starts; left Gordon Elliott for £10,000 last May
runners.name: Minella Crooner
runners.spotlight: His last win was at the Punchestown festival (3m, soft) in May 2024; right out of form in his last three starts (same Punchestown race last time) and this is his first start since leaving Gordon Elliott for £10,000 last May; probably best watched this time.

runners.comment: It's hard to know what to expect (market may guide) but he has Cheltenham entries
runners.name: Peaky Boy
runners.spotlight: Good third off this mark in a hot Cheltenham race (3m1f, good to soft) in December 2024 but tailed off in Grade 2 at Ascot (3m, good) on stable debut last February on his only start since; had wind surgery in September; it's hard to know what to expect (market may guide) but he has Cheltenham entries.

runners.comment: Won on Boxing Day; ran poorly at Cheltenham latest start but in the mix if bouncing back
runners.name: Prairie Wolf
runners.owner: G R Orchard & Mrs J M Gray
runners.spotlight: 5-17 over fences and his win at Aintree (2m4f, good to soft) on Boxing Day was up there with his best efforts; ran poorly at Cheltenham four weeks later but in the mix if bouncing back.

runners.comment: Tailed off latest; cheekpieces now; C&D win in January 2023 was one of his best efforts
runners.name: OToole
runners.spotlight: 9yo who is very lightly raced for his age; defied long absence to score over hurdles at Ayr (3m, soft) in January 2024; second over fences at Cork (2m5f, yielding) in November but tailed off at Haydock in December (had a wound to his left hind); cheekpieces go on and he's far from ruled out, particularly as C&D win in January 2023 was one of his best efforts.

runners.comment: First go at 3m did not work out in a Grade 3 handicap four weeks ago; of renewed interest
runners.name: Josh The Boss
runners.spotlight: Always ridden by Jamie Neild; walked over on his second chase assignment and easily made all in four-runner handicap at Doncaster (2m3f, soft) in November; another big run from the front when second of five at Aintree (2m4f) next time, before his first attempt at 3m did not work out in a Grade 3 handicap four weeks ago; he should be of renewed interest back at 2m4f.

runners.comment: 11yo, a zestful front-runner in recent campaigns; 2-5 for this yard but they were over 2m
runners.name: Sunnyvilla
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 11yo, a zestful front-runner in recent campaigns who has won over 2m in the mud on the first and latest of his five races for current yard; the latter was a five-runner race at Uttoxeter four weeks ago, since which he's gone up another 4lb but it's this trip (despite 2m4f and 2m5f wins much earlier in career) which provides the most glaring question.

runners.comment: Won two small-field chases; well handicapped were he to revive, but not proven beyond 2m1f
runners.name: Primoz
runners.spotlight: Two wins in small-field chases last season and ran creditably on his first two outings this term; those, however, have been followed by two heavy defeats; well handicapped were he to revive but he's not proven beyond 2m1f.

runners.comment: 5yo who won at Uttoxeter (2m4f, soft) four weeks ago; up 4lb but probably has more to give
runners.name: My Noble Lord
runners.spotlight: Flat winner who added a juvenile hurdle success last season and also scored at Uttoxeter (2m4f, soft) four weeks ago in his third handicap chase, travelling best before he needed strong pressure to get up; tongue tied last two starts and cheekpieces latest; up 4lb but probably has more to give.

16:33.race_name: Gemini Electrical Short Circuit Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle (Go North Sea Pigeon Qual')

runners.comment: Yet to make the frame in five starts but has shown signs of ability; handicap debut
runners.name: Supreme Shot
runners.spotlight: Yet to make the frame in five starts, although he has shown signs of ability and now makes his handicap debut; hood left off after one run; worth monitoring in the market.

runners.comment: Lightly raced for his age; good second at Uttoxeter in November; stronger claims than most
runners.name: Justlikefire
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced for his age; best effort when second of eight at Uttoxeter (2m, soft; 7-1) in November, pulling clear of the remainder; off three months since but has stronger claims than most.

runners.comment: Beaten long way on handicap debut at Sedgefield and has something to prove
runners.name: My My My Delilah
runners.spotlight: Made the frame in three bumpers but well held in four runs over hurdles, beaten a long way on handicap debut at Sedgefield (2m1f, good to soft) last month; something to prove.

runners.comment: Just 1-12 over hurdles and lost two places late on when fourth at Kelso; more required
runners.name: Shes Notjoeking
runners.spotlight: Usually gives her running but just 1-12 over hurdles and she lost two places late on when fourth at Kelso (2m2f, good to soft) just after Christmas; more required.

runners.comment: Convincing winner at Musselburgh on Sunday and looks well in under a penalty
runners.name: Sattam
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the tenth attempt at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) on Sunday, and in some style too, eased after surging well clear from three out; looks well in under a penalty; has a good chance of following up.

runners.comment: Beaten at least 27l all starts; needs recent wind op to have had a transformative effect
runners.name: Elusive Warrior
runners.owner: S McMillan M Gabellone P Thompson
runners.spotlight: Beaten at least 27l all starts; now makes handicap debut and needs recent wind surgery to have had a transformative effect.

runners.comment: Last win came off 10lb higher but she seems to have been going through the motions of late
runners.name: Kellies Dream
runners.spotlight: Last win (in Ireland) came off a 10lb higher mark but she seems to have been going through the motions of late, beating only one home at Carlisle (2m1f, soft; 13-2) in December; needs a revival.

runners.breeder: L Fleury & Ecurie Bred To Win
runners.comment: Belied big odds when placed on hurdle debut at Hereford; a possible
runners.name: Lipstick
runners.spotlight: Only eighth of 11 in soft-ground course bumper on debut in November but belied triple-digit odds when third over hurdles at Hereford (2m, good to soft) the following month and has possibilities if able to build on that performance here.

runners.comment: Second in two Irish points last year but well beaten on rules debut at Ffos Las yesterday
runners.name: Makinbecon
runners.spotlight: Brother to very useful chaser De Rasher Counter; runner-up in two Irish points last spring but soundly beaten on rules debut at Ffos Las yesterday.

runners.comment: Beaten odds-on favourite when second in both hurdles races; in the mix again here
runners.name: Marhaba Prince
runners.spotlight: Won a soft-ground bumper for another stable last season; beaten odds-on favourite when second on both hurdling starts, the latter at Wincanton (1m7f, heavy) one week ago, but has each-way claims at least here.

runners.comment: Kept on well for second at Leicester last month and probably still has potential
runners.name: Mister Ursus
runners.spotlight: Won twice on the Flat in Poland in 2024 and once in France last year; sometimes races a bit too freely but has made the frame on both hurdling starts, more recently when keeping-on second at Leicester (1m7f, heavy) last month, and probably still has potential over jumps; likely contender.

runners.breeder: Societe Civile De LEcurie De Meautry
runners.comment: Very useful on the Flat in France and looks interesting on stable/hurdle debut
runners.name: Mr Diafoirus
runners.spotlight: Very useful on the Flat in France for Andre Fabre; changed hands for 25,000euros after finishing last of five in 1m7f Group 3 in September and it's interesting that his new French trainer has sent him here for his hurdling debut.

runners.comment: Did not get competitive when 200-1 for soft-ground C&D novice on recent hurdle debut
runners.name: Passage Du Maure
runners.spotlight: Did not get competitive when 200-1 for soft-ground C&D novice on recent hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Showed some ability in Irish bumpers last year but soundly beaten on both hurdle starts
runners.name: Stone Cold
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability in Irish bumpers last year (good/good to yielding) but soundly beaten at 100-1 in two hurdles for new stable this winter.

runners.comment: Struggled when 200-1 for last month's hurdling debut at Uttoxeter
runners.name: Yourcardismarked
runners.spotlight: Has a good jumping pedigree but struggled when 200-1 for last month's hurdling debut at Uttoxeter (2m, soft).

runners.comment: A long way off the pace when unseating rider at third-last flight on hurdle debut
runners.name: I Heard A Rumour
runners.spotlight: Sister to stable's useful bumper/hurdle winner Listentoyourheart; a long way off the pace when unseating rider at third-last flight over C&D (soft) on recent debut.

runners.comment: Made quite promising bumper debut but soundly beaten on both hurdling starts
runners.name: Paradise Park
runners.spotlight: Made fairly encouraging debut in soft-ground bumper in 2024 but soundly beaten on both subsequent hurdling starts, the latter at Taunton (2m3f, heavy) nine days ago.

14:17.race_name: Pertemps Network Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Useful hurdler in his prime but out of form this season; chase debut today
runners.name: Pyramid Place
runners.owner: Royal Arch Racing Pp & Gary Campbell
runners.spotlight: Nine-time hurdle winner who was useful in his prime and is versatile regarding ground; out of form since rejoining Harriet Dickin this season, though, and has left it late in the day to launch his chasing career; hood/cheekpieces removed; first-time blinkers tried.

runners.comment: Has made promising start to chasing career; comes here after winning a recent match race
runners.name: Star Of Affinity
runners.spotlight: Built upon quite promising seasonal/chase debut when second at Wincanton (1m7f, good) in November, and easily won a match race at Plumpton (2m4f, soft) this month; went up 4lb for that recent success but can still make his presence felt here.

runners.breeder: S C E A Haras Du Ma & Mr Marc Dumont
runners.comment: 0-9 over fences but has posted some good efforts this season; respected
runners.name: Risk De Pluie
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over fences but has posted some good efforts this season, most recently when second at Sandown (2m4f, soft) three weeks ago; should be fine on this left-handed track; respected.

runners.comment: Five-time hurdle winner; safely held in first three chases; needs to up his game here
runners.name: My Friend Sean
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner over hurdles (once here) but began chasing career with three underwhelming runs in the autumn (all 2m); back on a good mark now and ought to be aided by the refitted cheekpieces but still has something to prove over fences.

runners.comment: Unexposed 7yo who showed clear promise as a novice hurdler last season; chase debut today
runners.name: Jack To Bat
runners.owner: Martyn & Elaine Booth & The Maiden Over
runners.spotlight: Very unexposed 7yo who came second in a soft-ground Irish point in 2023 and made the frame in three maiden hurdles (2m3f-2m4f) last season; makes chase/handicap debut after ten-month absence but good market support will make him of strong interest.

runners.comment: Scored over hurdles here in December and followed up on recent chasing debut at Doncaster
runners.name: Another Fine Mess
runners.spotlight: Pipped a next-time-out winner to score over hurdles here (2m, good to soft) just after Christmas and took another step forward when winning by 3l on chasing debut at Doncaster (2m4f, soft) 16 days ago; still unexposed over this sort of trip and makes obvious appeal.

runners.breeder: G F A Du Pont Rouge
runners.comment: In good form when last seen in the autumn but others here may have more potential
runners.name: Gris Majeur
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Brian Davies
runners.spotlight: Came good over fences in four-runner contest on seasonal debut at Ludlow (2m4f, good to firm) in October and was placed on next two outings (good/good to firm); also suited by soft/heavy ground but this is his first run for over 12 weeks and others in the field probably have more potential.

runners.comment: Seemed to be running well before falling two starts ago but struggled last time; risky
runners.name: Holeshot
runners.spotlight: Just ahead of Gris Majeur when falling at third-last fence at Taunton (2m7f, good to firm) in November, his second chase, but struggled on next outing; others in this line-up look much less risky.

runners.comment: 5-19 over hurdles; on fairly tough mark for chase debut and wants better ground
runners.name: Melton Mossy
runners.spotlight: 5-19 over hurdles, the latest win gained at Taunton (2m3f, good to firm) in November; makes chasing debut from fairly tough mark, though, and does not have a good record on soft ground.

runners.comment: Had uninspiring form over hurdles but is open to improvement on this chase/handicap debut
runners.name: Arctic Conditions
runners.spotlight: Well held when third in uncompetitive novice hurdle here (2m7f, good to soft) in December and did not show a great deal in two hurdle races either side of that; however, he was unlucky not to win a slow-ground Irish point in 2024 and is open to improvement on this chase/handicap debut.

14:55.race_name: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (Pertemps Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Mostly running with credit; only 2lb off career-high mark; cheekpieces off; 5lb claimer on
runners.name: Gowel Road
runners.spotlight: Cheltenham regular, where he won a 3m Grade 2 last January from Monmiral; ran creditably there on three of his latest four starts but he's only 2lb off his career-high mark; cheekpieces (worn on last three starts) are off; 5lb claimer is recruited.

runners.breeder: S A R L Carion Emm
runners.comment: 2024 Pertemps Final winner; Freddie Keighley takes off 7lb on this return to a handicap
runners.name: Monmiral
runners.owner: Sir A Ferguson G Mason L Hales The Late J Hales
runners.spotlight: 2024 Pertemps Final winner but that was off 8lb lower; contested two Grade 1s last spring, before a wind operation (his second) and heavy defeat when returned to fences three months ago (easily his worst chase performance); Freddie Keighley takes off 7lb on this return to a handicap.

runners.comment: Has had wind surgery since stable debut; he could still be one to be interested in
runners.name: American Mike
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the Champion Bumper in 2022 and won a 3m Grade 2 novice chase for Gordon Elliott in Febuary 2024; showed considerable spark in two tough 2m1f handicap chases last term, not disgraced on stable debut in November this season (had wind surgery since) and has a lower hurdles mark, so he could still be one to be interested in.

runners.comment: Achieved very little in this season's two runs since a long absence; stable back to form
runners.name: Green Book
runners.owner: Lady Price C Shaw C Boylan & I Tagg
runners.spotlight: Well treated on peak efforts; achieved very little in this season's two runs since a long absence, but at least his stable looks back to form.

runners.comment: C&D win at Christmas before the Lanzarote at Kempton proved too hot; each-way contender
runners.name: King Of The Lake
runners.spotlight: Registered a hat-trick last February/March and scored over C&D this Christmas to enhance record under his now regular rider Chad Bament; the Lanzarote at Kempton proved too hot for him on latest start (he was running respectably when falling at the last) but he's an each-way contender.

runners.comment: Respectable third to King Of The Lake here but not so good at Warwick on latest start
runners.name: Keable
runners.spotlight: Two soft-ground wins last term and another at Newbury (3m) on reappearance; respectable third to King Of The Lake here but not so good at Warwick latest; needs to find extra and 7lb-claiming amateur (who rode a winner for the stable last Saturday) is recruited.

runners.comment: Changed hands, left A Honeyball; it may not be enough even if he returns in peak form
runners.name: Firestream
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner here who returned from 718 days off to score on handicap debut at Wincanton (2m4f, good to soft) last January; there was some awkward jumping that day and again when creditable third in this race next time; absent since, has changed hands and left Anthony Honeyball; it may not be enough even if he returns in peak form.

runners.comment: Two 2nds before his heavy C&D defeat; had wind surgery since and now has tongue tied
runners.name: Ambion View
runners.owner: O C R Wynne & Mrs S J Wynne
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Newton Abbot (extended 2m6f) and Exeter (extended 2m2f) on his first two runs this term; weakened right out of it when upped in trip for King Of The Lake's C&D race at Christmas and had wind surgery soon afterwards; also now tongue tied first time and needs to resume progress.

runners.breeder: Shade Oak Stud & Mr D Jenks
runners.comment: On a hat-trick; more to prove in this field and on soft, but more to offer as a stayer
runners.name: Stones Throw
runners.spotlight: Stepped up to this sort of trip for last four starts and won three of them, from the front at Southwell and Doncaster on last two occasions; those were all in pretty small fields, he has more to prove on soft ground (he did win a bumper on it to start career) and has been raised another 7lb, but this 6yo also has more to offer as a stayer.

runners.comment: Third in a bog last time but as a lightly raced 6yo he should retain some potential
runners.name: A Perfect Day
runners.spotlight: Third run under rules when well on top in six-runner race at Lingfield (2m7f, good to soft) in December in his second handicap; not so hot off this revised mark when third in the bog at Wincanton (3m) latest, but as a lightly raced 6yo he should retain some potential.

runners.comment: Won at Market Rasen (3m, soft) three weeks ago; well held yesterday; 4lb out of handicap
runners.name: Gold In The Rivers
runners.spotlight: Sparked twice from five starts this term, grinding it out for a win at Market Rasen (3m, soft) three weeks ago on return from chasing; well held in the end at Ffos Las yesterday, however.

runners.comment: 2nd in this last term; out of form both starts after; off 308 days and 5lb out of handicap
runners.name: Rickety Bridge

runners.comment: Close second over C&D in December and went one better at Leicester last month
runners.name: Razzle Dazzle Boy

runners.comment: 0-5 over hurdles but both his handicap runs were very encouraging

runners.comment: Beaten a short head at Lingfield (7f) last month but last of ten over C&D last time.
runners.name: Edergoles Gift
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D in October off 6lb lower; ran up to her best when beaten a short-head at Lingfield (7f; first-time cheekpieces) last month, but failed to back it up when last of ten over C&D last time (cheekpieces absent); headgear returns and holds claims if they have the desired effect.

runners.comment: Got off the mark at the 15th attempt over C&D 13 days ago after a string of good efforts.
runners.name: Sanditon
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at the 15th attempt over C&D 13 days ago after a string of good efforts; holds every chance of following up off just 1lb higher.

runners.comment: Only 1-22 and looks to have gone off the boil; now tried in a tongue tie.
runners.name: Prefer The Sister
runners.spotlight: Only 1-22 and looks to have gone off the boil; dropped to career-low mark and sports a tongue tie for the first time; needs to show more.

runners.comment: Went off the boil in five runs for Thomas Faulkner and makes stable debut.
runners.name: Adelaide Bay
runners.spotlight: All three wins on AW when trained by Jane Chapple-Hyam in 2025; went off the boil in five runs for Thomas Faulkner and makes stable debut; best watched for now.

runners.comment: Won on just his second attempt at this trip at Southwell ten days ago with hood back on.
runners.name: Hint Of The Jungle
runners.spotlight: Has done most of his racing at 5f/6f but won on just his second attempt at this trip at Southwell ten days ago with hood back on (retained); up 3lb and must come into the reckoning.

runners.comment: Beaten favourite when last seen at Dundalk in December and makes stable debut.
runners.name: Drafted
runners.spotlight: Each of his three wins have been for different trainers; beaten favourite for Charles Byrnes when last seen at Dundalk in December and makes stable debut; best watched unless the market speaks in his favour.

runners.comment: Won handicaps at Wolverhampton and Lingfield in December; should be in the shake-up.
runners.name: Homme De Fer
runners.spotlight: Won handicaps at Wolverhampton and Lingfield in December; ran up to his best when beaten a neck at Kempton (1m) last month and ran well when third at Wolverhampton (7f) subsequently; remains in form and should be in the shake-up.

runners.comment: All five wins have been on AW at Newcastle; has been below his best of late.
runners.name: Tomorrow Day
runners.spotlight: All five wins have been on AW at Newcastle; has been below his best of late and has had his second bout of wind surgery since his last run; hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Beat Hint Of The Jungle at Kempton (6f) in December and has run respectably since.
runners.name: Vitalline
runners.spotlight: Beat Hint Of The Jungle at Kempton (6f) in December and has run respectably since, but is a hostage to fortune given his hold-up tactics with everything needing to drop right; cannot be discounted.

runners.comment: Five-time AW winner who went close over 7f here last time; respected back up in trip
runners.name: Charlatan
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he won at Wolverhampton (8.6f) in December and he did well to go close from a wide draw here (7f) last time; nudged up 2lb since that last run but he remains feasibly treated and this step back up in trip is a positive; respected.

runners.comment: 11-race maiden and she's not finished closer than fifth in handicaps; others preferred
runners.name: Fast Bullet
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on her best form but she's still a maiden after 11 starts and has not finished closer than fifth in eight handicaps (7f/1m); others preferred

runners.comment: 0-14 but she's finished runner-up in last two starts and should go well again; shortlisted
runners.name: Volendam
runners.spotlight: 0-14 but she's finished runner-up in 1m handicaps at Lingfield (Polytrack) and Southwell (Tapeta) in her last two runs; back up 2lb in the weights but she remains feasibly treated and should be in the thick of things again.

runners.comment: His last win was 12 months ago and he needs to raise his game after a break; visor added
runners.name: Mr Fustic
runners.spotlight: Five-time AW winner but his last success was 12 months ago and he couldn't make an impact in his final four runs last year; mark continues to fall but he needs to raise his game after a break; visor added.

runners.comment: Five AW wins and he caught the eye of the stewards at Lingfield (7f) latest; dangerous
runners.name: Semser
runners.spotlight: All five wins have been on AW, including two at this track; bounced back with creditable third at Lingfield (1m) last month and he caught the eye of the stewards when a never-dangerous sixth there (7f) last time; looks interesting on this step back up in trip and he should get a decent pace to aim at.

runners.comment: Triple course winner but he's been disappointing since his C&D win in October
runners.name: Kessaar Power
runners.spotlight: Can front-run; three of his four wins have been at this track but he's been disappointing since his C&D win in October; still 3lb higher than for that last success and he needs to turn things around.

runners.comment: Set strong pace when making all for a breakthrough win over C&D latest; respected up 2lb
runners.name: Shades Of May
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 15th attempt when making all over C&D last Thursday; that was a surprise at 33-1 but he did well to hang in there after setting a strong pace and a 2lb rise looks fair enough; respected.

runners.comment: Both wins were in 2023 and he's flopped in his last two runs; risks attached
runners.name: Wrist Art
runners.spotlight: Won twice in Ireland in 2023 but he's drawn a blank since; well treated on old form but has mixed record for current yard and he's flopped in last two runs; comes with risks attached and he needs to break much better than last time; cheekpieces are removed and visor returns.
